name: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc.
old_description: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling was founded in 2009 with the aspiration to become the Premier plastic injection molding supplier in the Southeast.  The owners of Premier Plastic, Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, came together bringing their combined experiences in injection molding to form a plastic manufacturing company with a focus on quality and service.  We are always committed to promoting our outstanding reputation by treating our customers with integrity and excellence.
about:
Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc. was founded in 2009 in Winder, Georgia, just northeast of Atlanta. The company was established by Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, who combined their experience in injection molding to create a plastic manufacturing business focused on quality and service. The founders aimed to become the injection molding supplier in the Southeast.

The company provides custom injection molding, tooling, and product development services. It assists entrepreneurs and inventors in taking concepts from prototype or sketch through to production. Plastic offers quick turnaround on orders and operates stocking programs to ensure customers have parts when needed. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Plastic serves a range of customers, from individual entrepreneurs and inventors to businesses requiring custom molded plastic components. The company does not specify particular industry sectors in its public materials.

The founders started the business with the aspiration to be the injection molding supplier in the region, emphasizing integrity, excellence, and personalized service regardless of order volume. The company highlights its American-owned and operated status and over 40 years of combined molding experience as key differentiators.

about:
Prettl Automotive, part of the Prettl Group, is headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina. The group was founded in 1953 by Franz W. Prettl in Germany and remains a family-owned business now in its third generation, led by Willi and Johannes Prettl. The company began as a small enterprise and grew into a global operation.

The automotive division focuses on manufacturing components and systems for the mobility sector, including DCDC charging units, mobile connectivity modules, and energy management systems. The group also produces metal components through its PRETTL Metal Components GmbH unit.

Primary customers are in the automotive industry, particularly original equipment manufacturers and tier suppliers seeking electrification and connectivity solutions. The company also serves the energy management sector and, as indicated by its ISO 13485 certification, the medical device market. Concrete examples from the input include automotive DCDC charging and RF-based mobile connectivity for vehicles.

The company emphasizes its family heritage and long-term perspective as a differentiator, describing its culture as one where employees act as "Eco-Preneurs" driving sustainability initiatives. This blend of tradition and forward-looking environmental responsibility is cited as a core reason for its enduring success.

about:
Prima Distribution was incorporated in Omaha, Nebraska, over two decades ago to address the need for a high-quality distributor serving the theatre and concession industry.

Today Prima operates as the Midwest's largest distributor of concession foods and equipment. From its Omaha facility, the company supplies a range of concession products and provides delivery across Nebraska, throughout Iowa, into portions of South Dakota, and the greater St. Louis region. The staff consists entirely of food-service professionals who average more than 25 years of industry experience.

Prima's customer base includes theatre chains, independent cinemas, concession stands, and other food-service operators throughout its delivery footprint. The company focuses on the theatre and concession sector, offering both food products and the equipment needed to prepare and serve them.

The business was started specifically to fill a gap in the Midwest for a distributor that could meet the specialized requirements of concession operators. Prima says it has built a reputation on excellent service and competitive pricing, backed by a team with deep industry knowledge.

name: Pristine Surgical
old_description: “The Summit arthroscope performed exceptionally well, and the procedure went according to plan,” said Dr. Mark Getelman, who specializes in arthroscopic and minimally invasive reconstructive surgery of the shoulder and knee at SCOI and is past president of the Arthroscopy Association of North America (AANA). “The ability to get a new 4K scope for every procedure while improving our workflow makes Summit an exciting product for our operating room. We’re proud to have performed this procedure at SCOI where surgical innovation has been a hallmark of our practice since our founding.”
about:
Pristine Surgical, based in Manchester, New Hampshire, is a medical device company focused on simplifying endoscopy through single-use visualization systems. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or original founders; its board includes representatives from Piney Lake Capital Management, a private equity firm.

The company’s flagship product is the Summit™ 4K single-use surgical arthroscope, a sterile, ready-to-use rigid endoscope that eliminates reprocessing, maintenance contracts, and sterilization delays. Pristine pairs the hardware with Pristine Connect®, a cloud-based platform that automates inventory management, stores images and video, and provides digital training checklists. A subscription model, branded Scopes as a Subscription™, replaces capital equipment purchases with predictable per-procedure pricing. The product pipeline extends to laparoscopy and flexible endoscopy, targeting a global addressable market of 125 million procedures annually.

Pristine serves hospital operating rooms, ambulatory surgery centers, and orthopedic practices. Early adopters include Southern California Orthopedic Institute, UCLA, Hospital for Special Surgery, Virtua Health in New Jersey, Doral Surgery Center in Florida, and Stetson Lee Orthopaedics in California. The company’s advisory board comprises surgeons specializing in shoulder, knee, elbow, and sports medicine.

Pristine was started to remove inefficiency, variability, and safety risks from the endoscopy suite. By delivering a new high-definition scope for every case, the company aims to reduce staff exposure to contaminated instruments, accelerate room turnover, and provide transparent, automated economics for surgical visualization.

name: Pro Form Metals
old_description: "The Pro Form Metals team was easy to work with, friendly, and they have done great work on my custom fabrication jobs. They get my projects done on time and are easy to communicate with regarding my project needs and the fabrication schedule."
about:
Pro Form Metals operates a family-owned fabrication shop on Dickerson Road in Reno, Nevada. The business was founded by Keith Goguen and builds custom architectural metalwork for projects across Northern Nevada and the Lake Tahoe region.

The shop produces custom chimney caps, fireplace surrounds, seamless gutters, kitchen range hoods, interior accents, railings, gates, and general brackets, guards, and caps. Work includes welding, forming, and cutting to spec for both one-off pieces and production runs. The company also supplies cut-to-length metal roofing panels and locally fabricated trim and flashings, though it does not perform roof installation.

Customers include builders, contractors, and homeowners in Reno, Sparks, Truckee, Carson City, Dayton, Fernley, Incline Village, Minden-Gardnerville, and the broader Lake Tahoe area. Projects range from residential kitchen hoods and chimney caps to commercial railings and architectural accents.

The company emphasizes local fabrication — everything is built in its Reno shop — and a collaborative approach: clients bring drawings, measurements, or reference photos, and the team discusses materials, finishes, and fabrication details before quoting.

name: Pro Shaper Sheet Metal LLC
old_description: Our shop handles TIG, MIG, and specialty welding for steel, stainless, aluminum, and more. From repair work to fully custom fabrication, we take on projects that require precision, strength, and practical problem solving.
about:
Pro Shaper Sheet Metal LLC operates from Charlton, Massachusetts. The business traces its roots to a family legacy of coachbuilding that began in 1960 when founder Wray's grandfather, Ted Billings, transitioned from a Worcester marina to restoring Auburn automobiles in Shrewsbury. Wray grew up in that shop, learning every aspect of metal restoration before establishing Pro Shaper as a bridge between traditional coachbuilding craft and modern fabrication demands.

The shop provides TIG, MIG, and specialty welding across steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, alongside full metal fabrication ranging from repair work to custom one-off panels. Core processes include wheeling, planishing, shrinking, stretching, and panel development for coachbuilding and structural shaping. Pro Shaper also designs and sells professional-grade shaping tools — such as shrinking discs, mallet sets, and lead-shot dollies — and runs small-group hands-on classes covering fundamentals through advanced surfacing techniques.

Customers span classic-car restorers, concept-car developers, and fabricators seeking to refine their panel-beating skills. Training and tooling are aimed at serious fabricators who want repeatable results at their own benches.

Pro Shaper positions itself on the principle that "control, patience, and the right tool — that is how great shapes happen." The firm differentiates by combining old-world coachbuilding discipline with contemporary tooling and instruction, building and sourcing tools that earn their place on the bench and teaching customers to maximize each pass.

name: Progressive Industrial Electrical
old_description: Progressive Industrial Electrical, Inc (P-I-E) is full service industrial electrical contractor and UL 508A panel shop.  We have been locally owned and operated since 2008.  Our company was founded on the principle that strong customer relationships are formed by offering high quality services at fair prices, emphasizing integrity and transparency.
about:
Progressive Industrial Electrical, Inc. (P-I-E) is based in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company was founded in 2008 and has been locally owned and operated since its inception. It was established on the principle that strong customer relationships are built through high-quality services at fair prices, with an emphasis on integrity and transparency.

P-I-E operates as a full-service industrial electrical contractor and a UL 508A-listed panel shop. Its service portfolio spans high-, medium-, and low-voltage power distribution, including pole setting, overhead line work, switchgear and transformer installation, motor control center (MCC) and variable frequency drive (VFD) installation and commissioning, and electrical design. The in-house UL 508A panel shop fabricates listed control panels. The firm also provides PLC/SCADA system design, upgrades, retrofits, programming, and HMI support, along with AutoCAD Electrical drafting, instrumentation installation and calibration, and industrial communications infrastructure such as fiber and copper Ethernet and network configuration.

The company serves industrial facilities requiring electrical construction, control systems, and panel fabrication. Its customer base includes organizations needing high-voltage distribution, switchgear, motor control, and SCADA integration, though specific industry sectors or named clients are not disclosed in public materials.

P-I-E distinguishes itself by offering in-house SCADA and controls capabilities alongside traditional electrical contracting, allowing it to deliver integrated electrical and automation solutions from a single source. The founding philosophy centers on transparent pricing and long-term client relationships.

name: Pronghorn Pump LLC.
old_description: Pronghorn Pump specializes in designing remote water systems based on each customers unique and individual needs. No two users are alike and neither are our systems. Built to your exact demands, we will help you meet your remote water pumping needs.
about:
Pronghorn Pump LLC was founded in 1996 and operates from Evansville, Wyoming. The company is led by Scott Blakeley, who holds certification as a pump installer and serves as the owner overseeing daily operations.

The firm specializes in designing custom remote water systems built around each client's specific requirements, with a core focus on solar-powered pumping units. Its capabilities extend to statewide installation and service, as well as water sampling, well testing, and groundwater monitoring. Each system is tailored to individual site conditions, ensuring that no two installations are alike.

Pronghorn Pump works with customers across Wyoming who need reliable water supply in off-grid or remote settings. The company's service area covers the entire state, addressing agricultural, residential, and commercial needs for sustainable water access.

Blakeley's hands-on involvement and the company's stated commitment to quality, availability, service, and value shape its approach. A guiding principle is to service every system the company sells, ensuring long-term support for installations. The owner's certification as a pump installer provides direct technical oversight.

name: Provisur Technologies
old_description: Produce high quality applications that hit all the industry trends — cleanly and efficiently. Our portfolio of leading food processing machine brands and decades of food science and sales experience help your business win in growing food markets.
about:
Provisur Technologies is headquartered in Mokena, Illinois. The company operates as a global manufacturer of food processing equipment, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

Provisur designs and builds equipment under several established brands, including Weiler mixer grinders, Formax forming systems, Beehive separators, and Lutetia defrosting tumblers. Its portfolio covers grinding, forming, slicing, mechanical separation, defrosting, marinating, cooking, pasteurizing, and chilling. The company employs approximately 3,000 people worldwide and maintains two Ingenuity Centers where customers can test new technologies and processes.

The equipment serves meat, poultry, seafood, and prepared-food processors. Typical applications include ground and formed products such as burgers, chicken nuggets, meatballs, and fish sticks; sliced products including bacon; mechanically separated proteins; whole-muscle and bone-in items; and automated cooking, pasteurizing, and chilling lines.

Provisur emphasizes its portfolio of brands backed by decades of food science and sales experience, a global staff of processing professionals, and a focus on innovation, customization, and high performance to deliver quality control, throughput, flexibility, and hygiene.

name: Prysmian Group USA
old_description: Prysmian Group is a global cable manufacturer. In the U.S., produces power and specialty cables for electrical utilities, telecom and industrial applications. Operates manufacturing facilities in Texas among other states.
about:
Prysmian Group USA is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The U.S. operating unit of the global Prysmian Group was established in 2005, though the parent company traces its roots back 150 years in cable manufacturing. The group operates in over 50 countries and employs approximately 34,000 people worldwide, with more than 15,000 in the United States.

The company manufactures power, data, and telecommunication cables for electrical utilities, telecommunications providers, and industrial customers. Its product portfolio includes high-voltage transmission cables, submarine cable systems, low-carbon aluminum cables, and hollow-core fiber for AI-ready data centers. Manufacturing facilities are located in Texas and other states, supporting a diversified production footprint across the group's global network.

Prysmian serves the utilities, oil and gas, telecommunications, and data center sectors. Its cables are used in power grid transmission, digital infrastructure, electrification projects, and renewable energy installations such as wind farm interconnections. Recent acquisitions, including Xtera for submarine telecom and Atkore for electrical raceway systems, expand its reach in North American markets.

The company emphasizes a diversified business model across geographies and product lines, coupled with a focus on low-carbon cable technologies to reduce the environmental footprint of digital and energy infrastructure.
